scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did excellent work identifying the primary root cause - HotReload test files being unconditionally included in the net472 build which lacks .NET Core-only APIs. The investigation was methodical despite challenges with parsing the binary log format. However, it missed identifying a separate category of errors on net10.0 and didn't fully articulate the cascade nature of type-inference errors downstream of undefined symbols.

The report is well-structured and every claim is supported by specific data from the binlog.

The qualitative analysis is strong and the conclusions are well-supported by evidence from the binlog.
